youtube.title: Count the Leaves with Twiggy! (TICKLE!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🍂 TICKLE! Someone tickled Twiggy the tree, Twiggy giggled, and all the fall leaves fell down! Can you help Twiggy count them back?

Count from 1 to 10 with Twiggy, the nerdiest tree in the forest! Each red, orange, yellow, green and brown fall leaf comes back one by one with its number and its word. Then sing the leaf counting song with Twiggy, and stay till the end to find out who did the tickling! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Count from 1 to 10
✔️ See each number and its word (1 = ONE)
✔️ Spot the colors of fall leaves
✔️ Sing a leaf counting song with Twiggy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Twiggy!
0:04 TICKLE! Oh no!
0:09 Let's count the leaves!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Who tickled Twiggy?
0:56 What color are the leaves near you?

💬 What color are the leaves near you? Tell Twiggy in the comments!
